title: Sister, Sister
description:

When a high school football star needs a tutor, Tamera pretends to be Tia so she can teach him a special lesson in "chemistry"!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E4 — History A La Cart
An embarrassing arrest from his college days comes back to haunt Ray, and Lisa turns an inheritance into a shopping spree.

title: The Game
description:
S4 E9 — A Very Special Episode
When Malik turns down the advances of the wife of the Sabers' owner, she becomes upset and returns with a vengeance, unwilling to take "no" for an answer.

title: The Game
description:
S4 E10 — Whip It...Whip It Good
Jason decides to leave a wild Brittany with the ultimate babysitter... Tasha.

title: The Game
description:
S4 E11 — Never Surrender!
Malik tries to end things with Parker so he can live an honest life with Jenna, but things don't go exactly as planned.

title: The Game
description:
S4 E12 — Death Becomes Her
When Tasha finds out her new man has a terminal illness, they spend his final days tackling their bucket lists.

title: The Game
description:
S4 E13 — The Right To Choose Episode
After trying unsuccessfully to get pregnant, Melanie and Derwin visit a fertility specialist, but the visit to the fertility specialist reveals more than Melanie bargained for.

title: The Game
description:

In the fifth season premiere, Melanie contends with Derwin's abortion accusation by leading him to believe he was the father of a child she terminated in college.

title: The Game
description:
S5 E2 — Truth Pact
In the second half of the fifth season opener, Melanie reveals a huge confession to Derwin regarding the abortion that he assumed was of their child.

title: The Game
description:
S5 E3 — No Money Mo Problems
Melanie feels like something is missing in her life after Derwin goes back to Irv as his manager.

title: The Game
description:

Melanie and Tasha's feud finds a public forum while preparing for the annual Sunbeams fashion show.

title: The Game
description:
S5 E5 — Grand Opening, Grand Closing
Jason's ego takes a hit when Chardonnay rejects his proposal about hooking up after their upcoming annulment.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E1 — Pilot
Jamie, a talented performer, dreams of success while working at an aging Los Angeles hotel.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E2 — The Bad Seed
Jamie tries to impress Fancy by becoming a mentor to Nelson, an innocent-looking kid. However, Nelson starts stealing various things from the hotel and lets Jamie take the blame. Orlando Brown guest stars.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E3 — Burned Twice By the Same Flame
Jamie foolishly believes that his engaged ex-girlfriend is in town to see him, so he asks Fancy to pretend to be his girlfriend.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E4 — Who's Da Man
Jamie coaches Braxton on how to attract women--with unexpected results.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E5 — We Finally Got A Piece Of The Pie
Jamie and Junior decide to start a business selling Helen's sweet potato pies. However, just when the business is about to take off, Jamie eats all of the orders.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E6 — ...And Bubba Makes Three
Braxton is embarrassed by his parents, who come to visit him and end up getting along better with Jamie than with their own son. Later, at a banquet in Braxton's honor, its members insult his parents.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E7 — Stuck on You
Junior entrusts Helen's wedding ring to Jamie after deciding to have it reconditioned for their anniversary. Jamie shows the ring to Fancy and Braxton, but when Helen arrives, he slips it onto Fancy's finger to keep the surprise from being ruined.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E8 — Kiss and Tell
At a Halloween masquerade party, Jamie mistakes Fancy for his date. Halloween episode.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E9 — Seems Like Old Times
Jamie is torn between his opportunity to get his career off the ground and his loyalty to his uncle Junior when he catches an entertainment attorney, a friend of Junior's, trying to coerce Helen into an affair. Lou Myers guest stars.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E10 — A Star is Almost Born
A director convinces Helen to let him film a movie in her hotel. The director casts Jamie in the role of the bad guy who is always getting beaten up. Jamie and the rest of the hotel crew soon tire of the director's rude behavior.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E11 — A Killer Ending
Jamie suspects that one of their hotel guests is an infamous serial killer.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E12 — A Thanksgiving to Remember
When a promotional scheme goes awry, Jamie and the others learn the meaning of giving thanks. Thanksgiving episode.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E13 — I Am What I Scam
Jamie gets jealous when Fancy's rich ex-boyfriend shows up at the hotel with a diamond ring and a proposal.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E14 — I Do, I Didn't
Jamie wakes up with a sexy woman--who is marrying someone else that day.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E15 — Little Red Corvette
Jamie buys a fancy sports car from a disreputable character and regrets it.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E16 — Act Like You Love Me
A movie actress friend of Helen's comes on to Jamie while she is in town teaching an acting seminar. Janet Hubert-Whitten guest stars.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E17 — Westside
Jamie finds it hard to follow Junior and Helen's rule to have no wild parties when they leave to go on vacation, and the Westside Connection (Ice Cube, Mack10, and WC) comes to stay at the hotel.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E18 — The Young and the Meatless
Jamie may have to eat his words after he tells Fancy that he is a vegetarian and later is offered a job as spokesman for a hamburger restaurant.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E19 — Step Up to Get Beat Down
Jamie suspects that he is being blackmailed by a record company owner and decides to cause a little trouble of his own. Tony Cox guest stars.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E20 — Break Yourself, Fool
Jamie is held hostage in a bank robbery.

title: The Jamie Foxx Show
description:
S1 E21 — I've Fallen and I Won't Get Up
When a guest fakes an injury so she can sue the hotel, Jamie must expose her lies.
